items.title: Smart Sentry v2 layout accessibility update: converted settings tabs in app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py to a left-side vertical tab rail so all tabs remain reachable in narrow panel widths, and moved runtime/serial log output into a dedicated always-visible bottom pane using a vertical splitter (with clear-log action) so logs remain visible while editing settings.

Smart Sentry v2 UI/preset completion: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now exposes motion self-suppression tuning on the Detection panel plus advanced precision, aim-lock, fire-gate, recenter, and target-loss controls on the Engage panel; detection and engagement preset application now updates those controls directly; engagement presets were expanded so each profile carries explicit values for the newly exposed fields; and tooltips were extended in app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tooltips.py so the advanced behavior is understandable from the UI.

Smart Sentry v2 detection/engagement refinement: hybrid detection modes in app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_detector.py now require corroboration from both selected methods instead of falling back to a single constituent detector, motion-locked overlap checks were tightened, engagement reacquisition in app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_engine.py now resists cross-target swaps by enforcing source/class/size proximity, active detection-mode changes reset live Sentry runtime safely, motion-mode suppression after turret moves was shortened for faster reacquisition, and Sentry v2 threat/engagement presets plus app/config/sentry_v2_settings.json were tightened toward center-priority aiming and firing while preserving each profile’s intent.

Smart Sentry v2 update: widened preset separation across detection, target filtering, threat scoring, engagement, and servo timing; added persistent no-fire-mask config support plus angular mask helpers, planner/fire gating, overlay rendering, a new video-canvas foundation, an initial Guard-tab live-click mask editor flow with right-click polygon finish, status/log feedback when a no-fire mask is actively blocking aim or fire, Guard-tab runtime diagnostics tools including change-only mask tracing plus a manual dump button for live projection/block verification, and a new engaging-state round scope view with adjustable radius and vignette opacity. Files: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py, app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_config.py, app/sentry_v2/engagement_planner.py, app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_engine.py, app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_overlay.py, app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_no_fire_masks.py, app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_video_canvas.py, app/config/sentry_v2_settings.json, SENTRY_V2_NO_FIRE_MASKS_AND_PRESETS_UPDATE.md, SENTRY_V2_SCOPE_VIEW_TROUBLESHOOTING.md.

Auto-fire alignment update: single-shot auto-fire in app/MAIN_FILE_SINGLE_CAM.py now fires from the active red aim-box target being centered near frame center on both axes, while preserving the existing cooldown, motion gate, stability gate, and trigger-pulse path. Deadzone still supports convergence, but it is no longer the single-shot fire command by itself.

Trigger and safety behavior clarification: manual fire remains on the standard fire path, Safety LOCKED disables auto-fire and drops Water-mode latched outputs (MOSFET hold / rapid-fire), and trigger-mode switching stays a non-firing configuration change. Documentation updated in README.md, CHANGE_IMPACT_REFERENCE.md, AUTO_FIRE_SYSTEM_VERIFICATION.md, and app/USER_MANUAL_UPDATE.md.

Filtered Target Mode preset + pipeline fix: added a factory Tracking Behaviour preset for small gray targets, extended preset application so Filtered Target color/HSV/filter settings load from the preset dropdown, and corrected mode 10 so motion/color/area filters are applied to detector candidates before SmartTracker instead of behaving like the other hybrid modes.

Detection feature added: app/MAIN_FILE_SINGLE_CAM.py now includes Filtered Target Mode, an additive detection mode that gates candidate boxes through enabled motion overlap, HSV color overlap, and contour-area checks before sending the final box list into the existing SmartTracker pipeline. The mode-specific toggles live in app/color_detection/ui_components.py and persist in settings.json.

Color detection fix: strengthened app/color_detection/color_detector.py and app/color_detection/hybrid_fusion.py so color masks survive overly aggressive cleanup, stage-level debug stats report where detections are being dropped, and color hybrid AND fusion accepts meaningful overlap instead of relying only on strict IoU. app/MAIN_FILE_SINGLE_CAM.py now logs mask pixels, contour counts, and produced boxes for color modes before SmartTracker handoff.

Prediction validation continuity fix: app/MAIN_FILE_SINGLE_CAM.py now records passive prediction error samples only across continuous valid target tracking, discards target-switch / hold-reuse / stale-async-YOLO cases, resets pending prediction comparisons on target loss, and exposes a discarded-sample counter in the stats output and camera-feed overlay.

Detection fix: Hybrid Color + Frame Diff in app/MAIN_FILE_SINGLE_CAM.py now fuses color detections against the actual frame-difference motion mask instead of relying only on box IoU, which was too strict for motion contours and could suppress valid colored moving targets.

Prediction diagnostics overlay: app/MAIN_FILE_SINGLE_CAM.py now renders passive prediction validation statistics directly on the camera feed when speed_debug_prediction is enabled, showing sample count plus average, median, and worst prediction error using the existing HUD text/background style.

UI responsiveness fix: floating dock drags no longer pause the camera frame timer. Updated app/MAIN_FILE_SINGLE_CAM.py so dock layout throttling applies only to real dock layout transitions and docked-widget relayouts, not when the floating Link / Log Output panel is moved around the desktop.

Camera stabilization follow-up: hardened camera backend acceptance and display rendering in app/MAIN_FILE_SINGLE_CAM.py by rejecting probe frames that open as black, detecting repeated all-black runtime frames for automatic recovery, and forcing QImage/QPixmap display copies to own frame memory instead of borrowing temporary buffers.

Camera black-screen fix: used app/link_log_31026.txt to confirm frames were still processing after camera open, then prevented REST-mode auto-hide from switching tabs/clearing the live video label while tracking, aiming, or camera capture is active. File: app/MAIN_FILE_SINGLE_CAM.py.

Camera pipeline stabilization: hardened capture open/read/recovery flow in app/MAIN_FILE_SINGLE_CAM.py with guarded async open, retry-on-read-failure, automatic reopen after repeated failures, invalid-frame checks, cached-frame display fallback during recovery, and optional disabled-by-default camera debug logging persisted in settings.json.

Passive diagnostics update: added optional prediction test session logging with `speed_prediction_test_mode`, automatic sample export to `logs/prediction_tests/`, and end-of-session summary statistics (sample count, average, median, worst prediction error). Files: app/MAIN_FILE_SINGLE_CAM.py, settings.json.

Documentation update: added Prediction Validation Test Guide with safe live-test steps for passive prediction diagnostics, required debug configuration, test scenarios, statistics collection via Ctrl+Shift+P, and baseline error interpretation. File: PREDICTION_VALIDATION_TEST_GUIDE.md.

Documentation update: added a Detection Freshness and Reuse Behavior section describing hold-window box reuse, async YOLO cache reuse, the meaning of the next processed aiming center, and how prediction diagnostics must be interpreted when inputs may be reused or cached. Files: CHANGE_IMPACT_REFERENCE.md, DETECTION_PIPELINE_PARITY_REQUIREMENT.md.

Documentation update: added Detection Pipeline Parity Requirement and a full detection-mode parity audit covering YOLO, FrameDiff, BackSub, Color, and Hybrid modes. Documented the shared convergence point before SmartTracker, identified stale-box reuse and async YOLO cache paths, and added a permanent Detection Change Impact Checklist. Files: CHANGE_IMPACT_REFERENCE.md, DETECTION_PIPELINE_PARITY_REQUIREMENT.md.

State ownership fix: separated go-home context to prevent collision between Manual Go Home and Target-Loss Home. Added `_go_home_context` (`manual`/`loss-home`), set context at each entry point, and gated completion restore so pre-home tracking/aiming snapshots are restored only for manual go-home. Target-loss home now clears motion state without restoring stale snapshot flags. File: app/MAIN_FILE_SINGLE_CAM.py.

Current Telemetry Fix (ESP32 UDP): app now drains `esp32_link` state events each control cycle and maps `current_mA` payloads into Health Monitor telemetry. Added safe total-current display fallback when the install checkbox is off (shows live telemetry without auto-enabling protection). Also retained raw total telemetry cache to prevent blank monitor readings from stale checkbox state. Files: app/MAIN_FILE_SINGLE_CAM.py, app/ui_builder.py.

Manual control reliability + ESP32 command LED patterns: in Debug Board hybrid mode, app now auto-attempts ESP32 Wi-Fi link when sending IO (manual fire/accessories) if link is not yet open. UDP firmware now blinks onboard status LED with unique non-blocking pulse counts per command category: motion=1, fire=2, accessory=3, safety=4, mode=5. Files: app/MAIN_FILE_SINGLE_CAM.py, arduino/DB3000_ESP32_UDP_Link/DB3000_ESP32_UDP_Link.ino.

Connection Panel UI clarity update: renamed ESP32 fields to explicit UDP labels, clarified Local UDP Port purpose (0=Auto), added mode-based field visibility (ESP32 USB only / Debug+Wi-Fi hybrid / Dual Port), and made Connect button state mode-aware in Debug mode (Connect ESP32 Wi-Fi / Connect Debug Board / Disconnect). Files: app/MAIN_FILE_SINGLE_CAM.py.

Hybrid Transport Fix: in Debug Board mode (COM9), Connect now also opens ESP32 UDP link from ESP32 Host/Port when provided, without requiring ESP32 USB serial. PAN/TILT stay on Debug Board bus serial, while IO/fire/relays/safety/mode are sent over ESP32 Wi-Fi link. Updated tooltip text to reflect this architecture. File: app/MAIN_FILE_SINGLE_CAM.py.

Connection State Sync Fix: centralized Connect button state refresh in app/MAIN_FILE_SINGLE_CAM.py so label/enabled state always follows real transport state (serial, debug-board bus, or ESP32 link), including startup after settings load and async connect callbacks. Prevents stale 'Disconnect' or stuck 'Connecting...' text when COM modes change (e.g., Debug Board on COM9).

Connection Panel UX Fix: Connect button now supports ESP32 UDP-only mode when COM fields are blank (auto-connect/disconnect using ESP32 Host/Port/Local Port), shows a popup warning if the PC is not on ESP32 Wi-Fi subnet (192.168.4.x), and routes live control commands over ESP32 link when COM is disabled. Files: app/MAIN_FILE_SINGLE_CAM.py.

Dual Port Retarget: switched primary IO board assumptions from Nano to ESP32 (COM10) while keeping Debug Board on COM9, updated Serial Device UI labels/tooltips + connection/status wording, updated local defaults (`settings.json`), and retargeted `test_nano_io.py` defaults/messages to ESP32 IO board behavior. Added ESP32 USB-serial IO firmware sketch for dual-port accessory tokens: `arduino/DB3000_ESP32_IO_Telemetry_2026/DB3000_ESP32_IO_Telemetry_2026.ino`.

Dual Board Restore: Re-enabled Nano+Debug Board serial architecture (COM-based) by restoring serial connection handlers, COM/baud + serial-device UI controls, dual-port command routing in send_serial_command (PAN/TILT -> Debug Board bus packets, IO tokens S/M/F/L/R/G -> Nano), and serial settings load/save keys. Also fixed dual-port IO duplicate-send regression risk by removing success-path fallback re-send. Files: app/MAIN_FILE_SINGLE_CAM.py, CHANGE_IMPACT_REFERENCE.md.

Firmware/UI Compatibility: Updated arduino/DB3000_ESP32_DIRECT_DEBUGBOARD sketch to accept current app payloads/actions (config, mode, fire, fire_hold, led, laser, rapid_fire), drive local trigger/relay pins (GPIO27/GPIO13/GPIO32/GPIO33), and report matching state/caps; also synced Help -> ESP32 Pin Assignments table to UART2 debug-board topology (removed old GPIO25/26 pan/tilt PWM entries). Files: arduino/DB3000_ESP32_DIRECT_DEBUGBOARD/DB3000_ESP32_DIRECT_DEBUGBOARD.ino, app/MAIN_FILE_SINGLE_CAM.py.

Firmware Fix: Fixed false CRC mismatches by copying the 'crc' string before removing it from the ArduinoJson document (prevents dangling-pointer compare). Restores reliable hb/cmd processing and ACK/state replies. File: arduino/DB3000_ESP32_UDP_Link/DB3000_ESP32_UDP_Link.ino.

Firmware Fix: bus_ping now reports bridge-aware health (bridge_rx_ok) and returns ok=true when both pan/tilt channels show RX activity even without strict DS ping packet validation. File: arduino/DB3000_ESP32_UDP_Link/DB3000_ESP32_UDP_Link.ino.

Firmware Fix: bus_ping UART2 baud scan now requires VALID servo ping packets before switching baud, preventing lock-on to noisy RX bytes (e.g., false 57600). If no valid ping is found, firmware reverts to default bus baud. File: arduino/DB3000_ESP32_UDP_Link/DB3000_ESP32_UDP_Link.ino.

Fix: Reinstated ESP32-only control path from ESP32 BOARD UPDATE and hardened UDP control for one-way links by treating socket-open as active and sending movement commands with expect_ack=false. Files: app/MAIN_FILE_SINGLE_CAM.py, settings.json.

Firmware/Test: Added ESP32 bus-servo diagnostics and checksum auto-mode (SUB vs XOR) plus cmd(action=bus_ping) to confirm UART2/bus responsiveness; updated verifier to request bus_ping. Files: arduino/DB3000_ESP32_UDP_Link/DB3000_ESP32_UDP_Link.ino, esp32_udp_command_verify.py.
Test: Added standalone ESP32 UDP communication test (hello/hb/encoder_request with CRC validation) to verify PC↔ESP32 link independent of the UI. File: esp32_udp_comm_test.py.
Fix: ESP32 Connect/Disconnect toggle now treats socket-open as an active link (even without replies), preventing repeated link threads and stale UI state. File: app/MAIN_FILE_SINGLE_CAM.py.
Fix: ESP32 UDP local port now defaults to ephemeral (0) if a privileged port is set; Connect button waits for real link status. Files: app/MAIN_FILE_SINGLE_CAM.py, settings.json.
